mapper.update: insert into sys_user_address(user_account, target_id, label, consignee_name, consignee_phone, province, city, district, detail_address, is_default, create_time, update_time, is_deleted) values (#{userAccount}, #{targetId}, #{label}, #{consigneeName}, #{consigneePhone}, #{province}, #{city}, #{district}, #{detailAddress}, #{isDefault}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{isDeleted})
mapper.select: select * from sys_user_address where user_account = #{userAccount} and is_deleted = 0
select pay_password from sys_user where account = #{account} and is_deleted = 0
